scope.purpose: Implement and verify the frozen E0041 D input generator on development data only.

safe_index_ohlcv_prefix.provenance: E0041 safe development copy; first excluded Opened timestamp was inspected without its OHLCV payload.

taker_flow_raw_archives.months: 2020-06 through 2026-06 inclusive; 73 local archives are present
taker_flow_raw_archives.protected_row_rule: In the 2026-06 archive, stop when open_time reaches 2026-06-30T23:58:00Z after reading only open_time; do not parse that row's remaining fields or any later row.

canonical_dynamic_reference.columns: Opened plus the exact 8 memory PCA columns and 8 ESN PCA columns for each frozen seed

canonical_model_feature_reference.projected_columns: Opened and the exact 70 columns in the E0041 bundle base_feature_order

decision_alignment.decision: T-60; feature input must be complete by the decision instant
decision_alignment.first_holdout_row: Opened=2026-06-30T23:58:00Z is excluded because it serves market_start_utc=2026-07-01T00:00:00Z

memory_and_esn.memory_projection_input_columns: the exact ordered 14 names above; not BASE70
memory_and_esn.esn_selected_columns: the exact ordered 14 names above for all three seeds
memory_and_esn.reset: initial reset at the first safe raw timestamp; also reset before the next observation after a non-one-minute gap or invalid source OHLCV candle, as defined by frozen code
memory_and_esn.update_order: emit state features only after updating with the current complete candle; preserve frozen engine order and scaler imputations
memory_and_esn.missing_policy: no interpolation or forward fill; keep masks and reset behavior exact

flow.missing_minute_policy: retain missing minute; do not forward fill; windows spanning missing source fields are invalid
flow.zero_quote_volume_policy: I missing if Q is zero; U and V missing if qbar is zero

base_features.order: the exact 64 selected BASE features followed by the six frozen taker_Z/V features, as recorded in the E0041 bundle
base_features.profile_source: regenerate RP/VP from safe raw candles and the frozen E0041 RP/VP configuration; broad incompatible cache is prohibited
base_features.indicator_source: reuse frozen selected indicator fit artifacts and existing project generators; no fitting or selection

model.member_order: exact E0041 per-member feature order; verify every sidecar and do not pad dimensions
model.ensemble: uniform mean of nine raw member probabilities, then the frozen terminal Platt calibrator
model.permitted_outputs: technical development predictions only; no labels, metrics, rankings, EV, fills, trades, or PnL

synthetic_cases: state-stream split at multiple row boundaries and fresh-process checkpoint continuation
first excluded Opened=2026-06-30T23:58:00Z row with synthetic payload only
missing/duplicate minute, NaN/inf, unknown/reordered features, transform/config mismatch, corrupt checkpoint and interrupted atomic save
change a later synthetic suffix and assert every earlier feature, state, and technical prediction is unchanged
predeclared_validation.references: E0041 development feature, flow, and dynamic artifacts with exact timestamp-key joins; independent raw replay; existing frozen state implementations and D member files

resource_limits.other_processes: observe only; do not terminate or wait on existing processes unless resource pressure exceeds the frozen budget

must_include: all three ESN reservoir states, last timestamps and warmup counters
rolling raw-candle tail sufficient for exact input feature continuation
flow rolling tail sufficient for the maximum configured rolling window and horizon
last processed Opened, next expected Opened, source row/byte position, source hashes
code/config/transform/bundle identities, reset status, state schema and integrity hash
checkpoint.write: atomic temporary file plus replace; verify state checksum before load
checkpoint.resume: reject corruption, identity mismatch, altered source, non-increasing time, skipped or duplicate boundary row; test from a fresh process without replaying the prefix

outputs.large_outputs: remain local and ignored; do not write a duplicate full feature matrix
